name: QuickFloat Chat
author: Delwar Hossain

sections.description:
QuickFloat Chat creates a customizable floating WhatsApp button on your website.

🟢 Key Features

  • Custom Icons: Upload your own logo or image.
  • Animations: Zoom, Fade, and Slide effects.
  • Shape Control: Circle, Square, or Rounded.
  • One Click Chat: Direct WhatsApp redirection.
  • Position Control: Left or Right alignment.
  • Device Visibility: Hide on Desktop or Mobile.
  • Analytics: Track clicks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quickfloat-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to QuickFloat Chat settings.
